# Northwind Estate — LLM Knowledge Summary

> Website: Northwind Estate (https://northwindestate.com)
> Location: Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
> Purpose: Official lead-generation & property informational portal for Northwind Estate residential project.

## 1. Project Overview
Northwind Estate is a modern low-density residential gated community situated in Sector 22D on Yamuna Expressway. The project offers luxury 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartment residences designed with wide balconies, vitrified flooring, and contemporary architectural elevation.

## 2. Core Specifications & BHK Configurations
- **3 BHK Luxury Apartment**: Spacious 3-bedroom layout with large living hall, wide balconies, master suite with attached bath, vitrified tile flooring, and UPVC toughened glass doors. Price/Area on Request.
- **4 BHK Ultra Estate Residence**: Ultra-spacious 4-bedroom executive suite with en-suite bathrooms, double-height balcony layout options, separate utility space, and premium fixtures. Price/Area on Request.
- **Finishes & Fittings**: Vitrified tiles in living/bedrooms, anti-skid balcony tiles, granite kitchen counter with SS sink, MS balcony railings, putty/OBD wall finishes, and gypsum tile grid false ceiling in bathrooms.

## 3. Location & Connectivity Advantages
- **Sector 22D Yamuna Expressway**: Strategic location in NCR's primary growth corridor.
- **Proximity to Jewar Airport**: Close access to the upcoming Noida International Airport (Jewar Airport).
- **Arterial Highway Access**: Direct connectivity to Greater Noida, Noida, Delhi, and Agra via Yamuna Expressway.
- **Infrastructure Expansion**: Benefiting from planned metro extension, proposed rapid rail, educational hubs, and industrial logistics parks.

## 4. Key Amenities
- Clubhouse & Social Lounge
- Temperature-Controlled Swimming Pool & Kids Pool
- Fully-Equipped Fitness Gymnasium
- Landscaped Zen Gardens & Walking Circuits
- Children's Safe Outdoor Play Area
- 24x7 Multi-Tier Gated Security with CCTV
- 100% Uninterrupted Power Backup
- Reserved Podium & Covered Parking
